notes: Ids b1-b79 follow build order, but ids b53-b66 and b72-b75 are skipped: the two ear sub-assemblies (steps 15-18) are in the 'ear' repeat and the two legs (step 22) are in the 'leg' repeat.

Element IDs and colours come from the inventory page. Where the inventory image was ambiguous I matched pieces by shape and colour. Examples: 4550324 as a tan tile 1x4 and 4626904 as a tan plate 1x4 with studs.
Part type 'lego-243126x' in new_part_types is an unused placeholder entry and can be ignored.

The 14 gray 1x2 bricks with side studs (6123809) are modelled with a top stud, side stud and bottom anti-stud. I gave the exact pairing of each bonded stud for the ring bricks, the blue 2x4 plates, the 4x4 back plate and the ears only approximate side-stud attachments, as the pictures don't make them clear.

Step 3 sub-assembly is read as a brown 1x4 plate with two stacked blue 1x1 plates at each end and a brown 1x2 plate with a clip stacked in the middle. The sub-assembly then sits on the blue 1x4 brick.
The shield (6071464) clips onto the step-7 clip plate (b27). The side the shield goes on is inferred from the cover photo.

The figure is built upside down relative to its final pose. The legs (blue 1x2 bricks plus black 1x2 plate feet) attach to the blue 2x2 plate b70 on the brown base plate b1. The black 4x6 base plate (b79) is then pressed onto the feet studs, and the printed '1' tile and black plates are added on that base.
Edges join only pieces that visibly connect; no electrical or other edge types apply.
